compute_multi_label_metrics: compute multi-label classification metrics from an iterable of predictions with one-hot labels and probabilities
create_metrics_namedtuple: create a MultiLabelClassificationMetrics NamedTuple with num_examples and mean_average_precision fields
validate_prediction_probabilities: validate that prediction probabilities are in the range [0, 1] before computing metrics
calculate_average_precision: calculate the mean average precision score using sklearn for multi-label binary classification
handle_empty_predictions: handle empty prediction iterables by returning metrics with zero examples and NaN average precision
